templates.why_chosen: Star-rated two-tier control figure (19 components, nesting depth 4): a Cluster tier predicts and schedules above a Server tier, whose Oversubscription Agent manages a segmented memory bar mapping colored bands to concrete example VMs.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack a cluster-level control tier above a per-server agent tier inside two dashed regions, and instead of a separate legend, resolve the color coding by mapping each memory band directly to a named example VM (GPVM1, CoachVM2) below; label bands in the box itself since this figure's colors are not otherwise legended.
